Account simulator — all March trades

—

Whole contracts only (contracts = amount ÷ (option price × 100), rounded down; a trade too small for one contract is skipped). Bought and sold at UW's 1-minute option prices for that contract, minus commissions and the slippage you set (UW minute data has trade prices, not bid/ask quotes, so slippage stands in for the spread: you pay that much above the trade price to buy and get that much below it to sell). Take-profit exits fill at exactly the target when the option's 1-minute high reached it while the trade was open, which is optimistic. One month of data; this shows what March would have done, not a forecast.

Data checks (per date, ✓/! on each date chip): Skylit board price vs UW candles (Skylit frames are stamped one minute after the candle they reflect; aligned they agree within about 0.3–2 basis points), missing minutes, king distance from price, and every trade re-scored on UW 1-minute highs and lows. Trade outcomes use the candles (stop first when stop and target fall in the same minute), so intrabar wicks count. Option prices: every trade's option traded in the signal minute and the exit minute (no stale prices). A spot-check of two boards against Skylit's live API is scheduled after midnight ET (daily credit cap).

Data: Skylit Trinity replay, one board per minute (gamma summed over the five listed expirations), March 2026; candles and option prices from Unusual Whales. Nodes are strikes within ±2% of price with at least 12% of the king's size (thicker = bigger; cyan positive, magenta negative, white = king). ▲/▼ is the node's change over the last 15 minutes. Engine trades: a 1-minute move through a node (30%+ of king) into a gap of 0.4%+ to the next node on the CURRENT board; buy the at-the-money 0DTE call (up) or put (down), stop 0.15% behind the node, target the next node. Touch markers turn green if the node held for 15 minutes and red if price broke through. March is one month inside the test's holdout period: 52 trades averaged +7.7% per option (+0.50R), 17 winners; the full Dec–May test has not validated any reactive rule yet.
